item.summary: test(agents): pin the plugin harness route in session-permission proof (#129582) run.session-permissions.test.ts set no provider, so the model resolved to the harness default anthropic/test-model and the mocked codex harness (which only claims codex/openai) never matched. Selection fell through to the built-in openclaw host harness, which both proved the wrong owner for a plugin-owned permission assertion and paid that route's one-time module compilation inside the test body. That starved the event loop for ~130s, tripped the 120s test timeout, and cascaded into the second test through the shared attempt mock. Pin provider/model so the plugin harness stays selected, install the harness's OpenAI auth fixture, and assert agentHarnessId so a future silent fall-back to the host harness fails loudly instead of only going slow. Refs #129385
